statement.zh: Shaw 牛津手册目录列出惯用年代——纳伽达约前 4000–3200、国家形成约前 3200–2686、古王国约前 2686–2160（Malek 章）——并注明各家绝对年代不一致。此为手册约定，非本仓独立重测年主张。
statement.en: Shaw’s Oxford handbook table of contents lists conventional ranges—Naqada c. 4000–3200 BC, state emergence c. 3200–2686 BC, Old Kingdom c. 2686–2160 BC (Malek chapter)—while noting that absolute dates disagree across authors. These are handbook conventions, not independently re-dated claims.
